## Rapport Complet d'Exploration - Projet PARIGO

- **Audio:** WaveSurfer.js 7.12.1

```
│   └── playlists/               # Pages playlists (structure présente)
├── components/
│   ├── features/                # Composants métier
│   ├── layout/                  # Header, Footer
│   └── ui/                      # Composants UI réutilisables
├── lib/
│   ├── mock-data.ts            # DONNÉES MOCKÉES (détail ci-dessous)
│   └── utils.ts                # Utilitaires
├── stores/
│   └── player-store.ts         # Zustand store pour le lecteur audio
└── types/
    └── index.ts                # Interfaces TypeScript
```

```typescript
  albumId: string;               // référence à l'album
  genres: string[];              // ex: ["Electronic", "Cinematic"]

  instruments: string[];         // ex: ["Piano", "Strings"]
  isVocal: boolean;              // true si contient des vocals
  waveform: number[];            // pré-générée (100 valeurs 0-1)
}

// Album - Recueil de pistes
interface Album {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  label: string;                 // maison de disques
  cover: string;                 // URL image
  description: string;
  tracks: Track[];               // pistes complètes
  genres: string[];
  moods: string[];
  releaseDate: string;           // YYYY-MM-DD
  trackCount: number;
}

// Playlist - Sélection personnalisée
interface Playlist {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  cover: string;

// Label - Maison de disques
interface Label {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  logo: string;                  // URL logo
  description: string;
  albumCount: number;

interface FilterState {
  genres: string[];
  moods: string[];

  instruments: string[];

  searchQuery: string;
}
```

### 3. STRUCTURE DES DONNÉES MOCKÉES

**Fichier:** `/Users/yoannandrieux/Projets/parigo/src/lib/mock-data.ts` (432 lignes)

#### **A. Listes de Référence (Énumérations)**

```typescript
GENRES: 12 valeurs
  "Electronic", "Cinematic", "Pop", "Rock", "Jazz", "Classical",
  "Hip-Hop", "Ambient", "World", "Folk", "R&B", "Reggae"

MOODS: 12 valeurs
  "Uplifting", "Dark", "Peaceful", "Energetic", "Melancholic", "Epic",
```

#### **B. Fonction de Génération Déterministe**

Les données sont générées de façon **reproductible** via une graine aléatoire :

```typescript
// Seeded Random: même seed = même résultat toujours
createSeededRandom(seed: number) → fonction RNG

// Génération d'ID basés sur seed
generateId(seed: number) → string de 7 caractères

// Génération de waveform (100 points)
generateWaveformData(length: number, seed: number) → number[]
  - Combine 3 ondes sinusoïdales
  - Ajoute du bruit
  - Applique une enveloppe
  - Résultat: tableau de valeurs 0-1
```

```typescript

  "/audio/sample-2.mp3"
```

### 5. IMPLÉMENTATION ACTUELLE vs PRÉVUE

#### **CE QUI EST IMPLÉMENTÉ (✓)**

1. **Génération de données mockées** complètes et déterministes
2. **Pages principales:**
   - Accueil avec hero, stats, dernières sorties, playlists populaires
   - Liste albums avec filtrage (label/genre)

#### **CE QUI N'EST PAS ENCORE IMPLÉMENTÉ (✗)**

1. **Authentification** - Pas de système d'utilisateur/login
2. **Backend/API** - Tout est en front avec données mockées
3. **Persistance** - Pas de base de données
4. **Favoris/Playlists personnelles** - UI prête (boutons), pas de logique

10. **Tests** - Aucun test écrit

## Rapport d'Exploration: Portfolio-Caro - Architecture Backend & NeonDB

### 1. APERÇU GÉNÉRAL DU PROJET

**Portfolio-Caro** est une application Next.js 16 hébergée sur Vercel, utilisant une base de données PostgreSQL sur Neon avec Prisma comme ORM. C'est un portfolio professionnel pour Caroline Senyk (gestionnaire de droits musicaux chez PARIGO), avec :
- Portfolio de projets (albums, documentaires, synchros, etc.)
- Gestion d'expertises (droits d'auteur, droits voisins, distributions)
- Page CV/Résumé
- Admin panel pour gérer tout le contenu
- Multilingue (FR/EN)


**2. Affichage des Expertises:**
```
1. GET /api/expertises?locale=fr&limit=3
2. → getAllExpertises('fr')
3. → prisma.expertise.findMany({ isActive: true, ... })
4. → Retourne: ExpertiseListItem[] (metadata seulement)
5. Pour le contenu complet: getExpertise(slug, locale)
6. → Parse frontmatter + sections markdown
```

**3. Gestion des Documentaires:**
```
1. GET /api/documentaires?locale=fr&label=13-prods
2. → prisma.work.findMany({ category.slug: 'documentaire', label.slug })
3. → Retourne documentaires avec productionCompanySlugs (JSON)
4. → Peut filtrer par co-productions
```

- Category → Asset (coverImage)
- Label → Asset (image)
- Artist → Asset (image)
- Expertise → Asset (coverImage)
- CV → Asset (photo)

### 11. REMARQUES IMPORTANTES

1. **Multilingue:** Toutes les traductions sont stockées dans des tables séparées (locale: 'fr' | 'en')
2. **React Cache:** Utilisation de `cache()` de React pour déduplication des requêtes
3. **Asset Management:** Les chemins sont stockés en `public/images/...` et convertis en URLs `/images/...` pour Next.js Image
4. **Markdown Expertises:** Contenu stocké en DB avec parsing frontmatter client-side
5. **Seed Data:** 5 fichiers JSON + 6 expertises markdown pour initialiser le contenu

8. **Audit Complet:** Logging de toutes les actions avec IP, user agent, metadata

**Schema Prisma adapte pour Parigo :**

```prisma
// prisma/schema.prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

// ============================================
// ASSETS (Audio, Images)
// ============================================

model Asset {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  path        String    @unique // /audio/tracks/xxx.mp3 ou /images/covers/xxx.jpg
  type        AssetType
  mimeType    String?
  size        Int?      // Taille en bytes
  duration    Int?      // Duree en secondes (pour audio)
  width       Int?      // Pour images
  height      Int?      // Pour images
  blurDataUrl String?   @db.Text
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  trackAudio    Track[]   @relation("TrackAudio")
  albumCovers   Album[]   @relation("AlbumCover")
  artistImages  Artist[]  @relation("ArtistImage")
  labelLogos    Label[]   @relation("LabelLogo")
  playlistCovers Playlist[] @relation("PlaylistCover")

  @@index([path])
  @@index([type])
}

enum AssetType {
  AUDIO
  IMAGE
}

// ============================================
// GENRES, MOODS, INSTRUMENTS (Tags)
// ============================================

model Genre {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?  // Couleur hex
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks    TrackGenre[]
  albums    AlbumGenre[]

  @@index([slug])
}

model Mood {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks    TrackMood[]
  albums    AlbumMood[]

  @@index([slug])
}

model Instrument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  icon      String?  // Nom d'icone Lucide
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks    TrackInstrument[]

  @@index([slug])
}

// ============================================
// LABELS
// ============================================

model Label {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  name        String
  description String?  @db.Text
  logoId      String?
  logo        Asset?   @relation("LabelLogo", fields: [logoId], references: [id])
  website     String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  albums      Album[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// ARTISTS
// ============================================

model Artist {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug      String   @unique
  name      String
  bio       String?  @db.Text
  imageId   String?
  image     Asset?   @relation("ArtistImage", fields: [imageId], references: [id])
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  links         ArtistLink[]
  contributions TrackArtist[]
  albumCredits  AlbumArtist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model ArtistLink {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  artistId  String
  artist    Artist   @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform  String   // spotify, soundcloud, instagram, youtube, website, etc.
  url       String
  label     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([artistId, url])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// ALBUMS
// ============================================

model Album {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  description String?  @db.Text
  coverId     String?
  cover       Asset?   @relation("AlbumCover", fields: [coverId], references: [id])
  labelId     String?
  label       Label?   @relation(fields: [labelId], references: [id])
  releaseDate DateTime?
  year        Int?
  spotifyUrl  String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  tracks      Track[]
  genres      AlbumGenre[]
  moods       AlbumMood[]
  artists     AlbumArtist[]
  favorites   FavoriteAlbum[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([labelId])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([isFeatured, isActive])
}

model AlbumGenre {
  albumId String
  album   Album  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  genreId String
  genre   Genre  @relation(fields: [genreId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([albumId, genreId])
}

model AlbumMood {
  albumId String
  album   Album @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  moodId  String
  mood    Mood  @relation(fields: [moodId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([albumId, moodId])
}

model AlbumArtist {
  albumId  String
  album    Album  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artistId String
  artist   Artist @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role     String? // producer, composer, etc.
  order    Int     @default(0)

  @@id([albumId, artistId])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// TRACKS
// ============================================

model Track {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug       String   @unique
  title      String
  albumId    String
  album      Album    @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  audioId    String?
  audio      Asset?   @relation("TrackAudio", fields: [audioId], references: [id])
  duration   Int      // Duree en secondes
  bpm        Int?
  key        String?  // Tonalite musicale (Am, C, etc.)
  isVocal    Boolean  @default(false)
  waveform   Json?    // Array de valeurs 0-1 pour visualisation
  isrc       String?  // Code ISRC
  trackNumber Int?
  order      Int      @default(0)
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true)
  playCount  Int      @default(0)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  genres       TrackGenre[]
  moods        TrackMood[]
  instruments  TrackInstrument[]
  artists      TrackArtist[]
  playlistTracks PlaylistTrack[]
  favorites    FavoriteTrack[]
  historyEntries ListeningHistory[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([albumId])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model TrackGenre {
  trackId String
  track   Track  @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  genreId String
  genre   Genre  @relation(fields: [genreId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, genreId])
}

model TrackMood {
  trackId String
  track   Track @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  moodId  String
  mood    Mood  @relation(fields: [moodId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, moodId])
}

model TrackInstrument {
  trackId      String
  track        Track      @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  instrumentId String
  instrument   Instrument @relation(fields: [instrumentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, instrumentId])
}

model TrackArtist {
  trackId  String
  track    Track  @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artistId String
  artist   Artist @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role     String? // composer, performer, featuring, etc.
  order    Int     @default(0)

  @@id([trackId, artistId])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// PLAYLISTS
// ============================================

model Playlist {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  description String?  @db.Text
  coverId     String?
  cover       Asset?   @relation("PlaylistCover", fields: [coverId], references: [id])
  userId      String?  // null = playlist editoriale
  user        User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  isPublic    Boolean  @default(true)
  category    String?  // Cinematic, Upbeat, etc.
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  tracks    PlaylistTrack[]
  favorites FavoritePlaylist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([isPublic, isActive])
  @@index([isFeatured, isActive])
}

model PlaylistTrack {
  playlistId String
  playlist   Playlist @relation(fields: [playlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId    String
  track      Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order      Int      @default(0)
  addedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([playlistId, trackId])
  @@index([playlistId, order])
}

// ============================================
// USER & AUTHENTICATION
// ============================================

enum UserRole {
  USER      // Utilisateur standard
  PRO       // Professionnel (acces licences)
  ADMIN     // Administrateur
}

model User {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  email            String    @unique
  emailVerified    Boolean   @default(false)
  name             String?
  image            String?
  role             UserRole  @default(USER)
  isActive         Boolean   @default(true)
  twoFactorSecret  String?
  twoFactorEnabled Boolean   @default(false)
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt

  sessions          Session[]
  accounts          Account[]
  playlists         Playlist[]
  favoriteTracks    FavoriteTrack[]
  favoriteAlbums    FavoriteAlbum[]
  favoritePlaylists FavoritePlaylist[]
  listeningHistory  ListeningHistory[]
  downloads         Download[]
  auditLogs         AuditLog[]
  notifications     Notification[]

  @@index([email])
  @@index([role, isActive])
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?  @db.Text
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([token])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model Account {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId         String
  user           User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  accountId      String
  providerId     String    // credential, google, etc.
  accessToken    String?   @db.Text
  refreshToken   String?   @db.Text
  expiresAt      DateTime?
  password       String?   // Hash pour credential auth
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@unique([providerId, accountId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Verification {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([identifier, value])
  @@index([identifier])
}

// ============================================
// FAVORITES
// ============================================

model FavoriteTrack {
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId   String
  track     Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, trackId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model FavoriteAlbum {
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  albumId   String
  album     Album    @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, albumId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model FavoritePlaylist {
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  playlistId String
  playlist   Playlist @relation(fields: [playlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, playlistId])
  @@index([userId])
}

// ============================================
// LISTENING HISTORY
// ============================================

model ListeningHistory {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId     String
  track       Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  playedAt    DateTime @default(now())
  duration    Int?     // Temps ecoute en secondes
  completed   Boolean  @default(false) // A ecoute jusqu'a la fin

  @@index([userId, playedAt])
  @@index([trackId])
}

// ============================================
// DOWNLOADS & LICENSES
// ============================================

enum LicenseType {
  PREVIEW       // Telechargement preview (watermarke)
  STANDARD      // Licence standard
  EXTENDED      // Licence etendue
  EXCLUSIVE     // Licence exclusive
}

model Download {
  id          String      @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  user        User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId     String
  licenseType LicenseType
  projectName String?     // Nom du projet
  usageNotes  String?     @db.Text
  ipAddress   String?
  downloadedAt DateTime   @default(now())
  expiresAt   DateTime?   // Pour licences temporaires

  @@index([userId, downloadedAt])
  @@index([trackId])
}

// ============================================
// AUDIT & NOTIFICATIONS
// ============================================

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  action     String   // CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, LOGIN, DOWNLOAD, etc.
  entityType String?  // Track, Album, Playlist, etc.
  entityId   String?
  metadata   Json?
  ipAddress  String?
  userAgent  String?  @db.Text
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([entityType, entityId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type      String   // NEW_RELEASE, PLAYLIST_UPDATE, DOWNLOAD_READY, etc.
  title     String
  message   String   @db.Text
  read      Boolean  @default(false)
  link      String?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, read])
  @@index([createdAt])
}
```

## PHASE 1 : Infrastructure Backend (Complexite : HAUTE - 2-3 semaines)

### 1.1 Configuration Prisma et NeonDB

**Fichiers a creer :**
```
/prisma/
  schema.prisma          # Schema adapte pour Parigo
/lib/
  prisma.ts              # Client Prisma singleton
  auth.ts                # Configuration Better Auth
```

**Schema Prisma adapte pour Parigo :**

```prisma
// prisma/schema.prisma
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

// ============================================
// ASSETS (Audio, Images)
// ============================================

model Asset {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  path        String    @unique // /audio/tracks/xxx.mp3 ou /images/covers/xxx.jpg
  type        AssetType
  mimeType    String?
  size        Int?      // Taille en bytes
  duration    Int?      // Duree en secondes (pour audio)
  width       Int?      // Pour images
  height      Int?      // Pour images
  blurDataUrl String?   @db.Text
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  trackAudio    Track[]   @relation("TrackAudio")
  albumCovers   Album[]   @relation("AlbumCover")
  artistImages  Artist[]  @relation("ArtistImage")
  labelLogos    Label[]   @relation("LabelLogo")
  playlistCovers Playlist[] @relation("PlaylistCover")

  @@index([path])
  @@index([type])
}

enum AssetType {
  AUDIO
  IMAGE
}

// ============================================
// GENRES, MOODS, INSTRUMENTS (Tags)
// ============================================

model Genre {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?  // Couleur hex
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks    TrackGenre[]
  albums    AlbumGenre[]

  @@index([slug])
}

model Mood {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks    TrackMood[]
  albums    AlbumMood[]

  @@index([slug])
}

model Instrument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  icon      String?  // Nom d'icone Lucide
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks    TrackInstrument[]

  @@index([slug])
}

// ============================================
// LABELS
// ============================================

model Label {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  name        String
  description String?  @db.Text
  logoId      String?
  logo        Asset?   @relation("LabelLogo", fields: [logoId], references: [id])
  website     String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  albums      Album[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// ARTISTS
// ============================================

model Artist {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug      String   @unique
  name      String
  bio       String?  @db.Text
  imageId   String?
  image     Asset?   @relation("ArtistImage", fields: [imageId], references: [id])
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  links         ArtistLink[]
  contributions TrackArtist[]
  albumCredits  AlbumArtist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model ArtistLink {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  artistId  String
  artist    Artist   @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform  String   // spotify, soundcloud, instagram, youtube, website, etc.
  url       String
  label     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([artistId, url])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// ALBUMS
// ============================================

model Album {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  description String?  @db.Text
  coverId     String?
  cover       Asset?   @relation("AlbumCover", fields: [coverId], references: [id])
  labelId     String?
  label       Label?   @relation(fields: [labelId], references: [id])
  releaseDate DateTime?
  year        Int?
  spotifyUrl  String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  tracks      Track[]
  genres      AlbumGenre[]
  moods       AlbumMood[]
  artists     AlbumArtist[]
  favorites   FavoriteAlbum[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([labelId])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([isFeatured, isActive])
}

model AlbumGenre {
  albumId String
  album   Album  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  genreId String
  genre   Genre  @relation(fields: [genreId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([albumId, genreId])
}

model AlbumMood {
  albumId String
  album   Album @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  moodId  String
  mood    Mood  @relation(fields: [moodId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([albumId, moodId])
}

model AlbumArtist {
  albumId  String
  album    Album  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artistId String
  artist   Artist @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role     String? // producer, composer, etc.
  order    Int     @default(0)

  @@id([albumId, artistId])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// TRACKS
// ============================================

model Track {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug       String   @unique
  title      String
  albumId    String
  album      Album    @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  audioId    String?
  audio      Asset?   @relation("TrackAudio", fields: [audioId], references: [id])
  duration   Int      // Duree en secondes
  bpm        Int?
  key        String?  // Tonalite musicale (Am, C, etc.)
  isVocal    Boolean  @default(false)
  waveform   Json?    // Array de valeurs 0-1 pour visualisation
  isrc       String?  // Code ISRC
  trackNumber Int?
  order      Int      @default(0)
  isActive   Boolean  @default(true)
  playCount  Int      @default(0)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  genres       TrackGenre[]
  moods        TrackMood[]
  instruments  TrackInstrument[]
  artists      TrackArtist[]
  playlistTracks PlaylistTrack[]
  favorites    FavoriteTrack[]
  historyEntries ListeningHistory[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([albumId])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model TrackGenre {
  trackId String
  track   Track  @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  genreId String
  genre   Genre  @relation(fields: [genreId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, genreId])
}

model TrackMood {
  trackId String
  track   Track @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  moodId  String
  mood    Mood  @relation(fields: [moodId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, moodId])
}

model TrackInstrument {
  trackId      String
  track        Track      @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  instrumentId String
  instrument   Instrument @relation(fields: [instrumentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, instrumentId])
}

model TrackArtist {
  trackId  String
  track    Track  @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artistId String
  artist   Artist @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role     String? // composer, performer, featuring, etc.
  order    Int     @default(0)

  @@id([trackId, artistId])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// PLAYLISTS
// ============================================

model Playlist {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  description String?  @db.Text
  coverId     String?
  cover       Asset?   @relation("PlaylistCover", fields: [coverId], references: [id])
  userId      String?  // null = playlist editoriale
  user        User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  isPublic    Boolean  @default(true)
  category    String?  // Cinematic, Upbeat, etc.
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  tracks    PlaylistTrack[]
  favorites FavoritePlaylist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([isPublic, isActive])
  @@index([isFeatured, isActive])
}

model PlaylistTrack {
  playlistId String
  playlist   Playlist @relation(fields: [playlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId    String
  track      Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order      Int      @default(0)
  addedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([playlistId, trackId])
  @@index([playlistId, order])
}

// ============================================
// USER & AUTHENTICATION
// ============================================

enum UserRole {
  USER      // Utilisateur standard
  PRO       // Professionnel (acces licences)
  ADMIN     // Administrateur
}

model User {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  email            String    @unique
  emailVerified    Boolean   @default(false)
  name             String?
  image            String?
  role             UserRole  @default(USER)
  isActive         Boolean   @default(true)
  twoFactorSecret  String?
  twoFactorEnabled Boolean   @default(false)
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt

  sessions          Session[]
  accounts          Account[]
  playlists         Playlist[]
  favoriteTracks    FavoriteTrack[]
  favoriteAlbums    FavoriteAlbum[]
  favoritePlaylists FavoritePlaylist[]
  listeningHistory  ListeningHistory[]
  downloads         Download[]
  auditLogs         AuditLog[]
  notifications     Notification[]

  @@index([email])
  @@index([role, isActive])
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?  @db.Text
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([token])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model Account {
  id             String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId         String
  user           User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  accountId      String
  providerId     String    // credential, google, etc.
  accessToken    String?   @db.Text
  refreshToken   String?   @db.Text
  expiresAt      DateTime?
  password       String?   // Hash pour credential auth
  createdAt      DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@unique([providerId, accountId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Verification {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([identifier, value])
  @@index([identifier])
}

// ============================================
// FAVORITES
// ============================================

model FavoriteTrack {
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId   String
  track     Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, trackId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model FavoriteAlbum {
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  albumId   String
  album     Album    @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, albumId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model FavoritePlaylist {
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  playlistId String
  playlist   Playlist @relation(fields: [playlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, playlistId])
  @@index([userId])
}

// ============================================
// LISTENING HISTORY
// ============================================

model ListeningHistory {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId     String
  track       Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  playedAt    DateTime @default(now())
  duration    Int?     // Temps ecoute en secondes
  completed   Boolean  @default(false) // A ecoute jusqu'a la fin

  @@index([userId, playedAt])
  @@index([trackId])
}

// ============================================
// DOWNLOADS & LICENSES
// ============================================

enum LicenseType {
  PREVIEW       // Telechargement preview (watermarke)
  STANDARD      // Licence standard
  EXTENDED      // Licence etendue
  EXCLUSIVE     // Licence exclusive
}

model Download {
  id          String      @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  user        User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId     String
  licenseType LicenseType
  projectName String?     // Nom du projet
  usageNotes  String?     @db.Text
  ipAddress   String?
  downloadedAt DateTime   @default(now())
  expiresAt   DateTime?   // Pour licences temporaires

  @@index([userId, downloadedAt])
  @@index([trackId])
}

// ============================================
// AUDIT & NOTIFICATIONS
// ============================================

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  action     String   // CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, LOGIN, DOWNLOAD, etc.
  entityType String?  // Track, Album, Playlist, etc.
  entityId   String?
  metadata   Json?
  ipAddress  String?
  userAgent  String?  @db.Text
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([entityType, entityId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type      String   // NEW_RELEASE, PLAYLIST_UPDATE, DOWNLOAD_READY, etc.
  title     String
  message   String   @db.Text
  read      Boolean  @default(false)
  link      String?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, read])
  @@index([createdAt])
}
```

# Plan Complet : Parigo MVP vers Application Full-Stack

## Objectif
Transformer Parigo d'un MVP frontend avec mock data en une application complète avec :
- Backend NeonDB (nouvelle base dédiée)
- Données réelles depuis portfolio-caroline + API Spotify pour les tracks
- Stockage assets sur Vercel Blob
- Toutes les features : Auth, Favoris, Labels/Artists pages, Admin Panel, Licences/Download

---

## Phase 1 : Infrastructure Backend

### 1.1 Configuration NeonDB + Prisma

**Fichiers à créer :**
```
/prisma/schema.prisma          # Schéma complet (voir ci-dessous)
/prisma/migrations/            # Auto-généré
/lib/prisma.ts                 # Client Prisma singleton
/prisma.config.ts              # Configuration Prisma
```

**Fichiers à modifier :**
```
/.env.local                    # Ajouter DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL
/package.json                  # Nouvelles dépendances
```

**Dépendances à installer :**
```bash
pnpm add @prisma/client better-auth zod @tanstack/react-query bcryptjs @vercel/blob
pnpm add -D prisma tsx
```

### 1.2 Schéma Prisma Parigo

```prisma
// Modèles principaux (26 tables)

// ASSETS
Asset (id, path, type, mimeType, size, duration, width, height, blurDataUrl)

// TAGS
Genre (id, name, slug, color, order, isActive)
Mood (id, name, slug, color, order, isActive)
Instrument (id, name, slug, icon, order, isActive)

// CONTENT
Label (id, slug, name, description, logoId, website, order, isActive)
Artist (id, slug, name, bio, imageId, order, isActive)
ArtistLink (id, artistId, platform, url, label, order)
Album (id, slug, title, description, coverId, labelId, releaseDate, spotifyUrl, order, isActive, isFeatured)
Track (id, slug, title, albumId, audioId, duration, bpm, key, isVocal, waveform, isrc, trackNumber, order, isActive, playCount)

// RELATIONS MANY-TO-MANY
AlbumGenre, AlbumMood, AlbumArtist
TrackGenre, TrackMood, TrackInstrument, TrackArtist

// PLAYLISTS
Playlist (id, slug, title, description, coverId, userId, isPublic, category, order, isActive, isFeatured)
PlaylistTrack (playlistId, trackId, order, addedAt)

// USER & AUTH
User (id, email, emailVerified, name, image, role[USER/PRO/ADMIN], isActive, twoFactorEnabled)
Session, Account, Verification

// USER FEATURES
FavoriteTrack, FavoriteAlbum, FavoritePlaylist
ListeningHistory (id, userId, trackId, playedAt, duration, completed)
Download (id, userId, trackId, licenseType, projectName, downloadedAt)

// ADMIN
AuditLog (id, userId, action, entityType, entityId, metadata)
Notification (id, userId, type, title, message, read, link)
```

---

## Phase 2 : Migration des Données

### 2.1 Copier les assets de portfolio-caroline

**Fichiers source :**
```
/Users/yoannandrieux/Projets/portfolio-caro/seed-data/
├── artists.json      (100+ artistes)
├── works.json        (200+ albums)
├── categories.json   (5 catégories → genres)
├── labels.json       (4 labels)
```

**Scripts à créer :**
```
/scripts/db/
├── seed.ts                      # Seed principal
├── reset.ts                     # Reset DB
├── migrate-from-portfolio.ts    # Import données portfolio-caro
├── fetch-spotify-tracks.ts      # Récupérer tracks via API Spotify
└── generate-waveforms.ts        # Générer waveforms pour tracks
```

### 2.2 Intégration API Spotify

**Fichiers à créer :**
```
/lib/spotify.ts                  # Client API Spotify
/scripts/spotify/
├── auth.ts                      # OAuth Spotify
└── fetch-album-tracks.ts        # Récupérer tracks d'un album
```

**Flux :**
1. Pour chaque album dans works.json avec spotifyUrl
2. Appeler Spotify API `/albums/{id}/tracks`
3. Récupérer: titre, durée, numéro de piste, ISRC, preview_url
4. Stocker dans table Track

### 2.3 Upload assets vers Vercel Blob

**Script :**

**Migration :**

# Plan Complet : Parigo MVP vers Application Full-Stack

## Objectif
Transformer Parigo d'un MVP frontend avec mock data en une application complète avec :
- Backend NeonDB (nouvelle base dédiée)
- Données réelles depuis portfolio-caroline + API Spotify pour les tracks
- Stockage assets sur Vercel Blob
- Toutes les features : Auth, Favoris, Labels/Artists pages, Admin Panel, Licences/Download

---

## Phase 1 : Infrastructure Backend

### 1.1 Configuration NeonDB + Prisma

**Fichiers à créer :**
```
/prisma/schema.prisma          # Schéma complet (voir ci-dessous)
/prisma/migrations/            # Auto-généré
/lib/prisma.ts                 # Client Prisma singleton
/prisma.config.ts              # Configuration Prisma
```

**Fichiers à modifier :**
```
/.env.local                    # Ajouter DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL
/package.json                  # Nouvelles dépendances
```

**Dépendances à installer :**
```bash
pnpm add @prisma/client better-auth zod @tanstack/react-query bcryptjs @vercel/blob
pnpm add -D prisma tsx
```

### 1.2 Schéma Prisma Parigo

```prisma
// Modèles principaux (26 tables)

// ASSETS
Asset (id, path, type, mimeType, size, duration, width, height, blurDataUrl)

// TAGS
Genre (id, name, slug, color, order, isActive)
Mood (id, name, slug, color, order, isActive)
Instrument (id, name, slug, icon, order, isActive)

// CONTENT
Label (id, slug, name, description, logoId, website, order, isActive)
Artist (id, slug, name, bio, imageId, order, isActive)
ArtistLink (id, artistId, platform, url, label, order)
Album (id, slug, title, description, coverId, labelId, releaseDate, spotifyUrl, order, isActive, isFeatured)
Track (id, slug, title, albumId, audioId, duration, bpm, key, isVocal, waveform, isrc, trackNumber, order, isActive, playCount)

// RELATIONS MANY-TO-MANY
AlbumGenre, AlbumMood, AlbumArtist
TrackGenre, TrackMood, TrackInstrument, TrackArtist

// PLAYLISTS
Playlist (id, slug, title, description, coverId, userId, isPublic, category, order, isActive, isFeatured)
PlaylistTrack (playlistId, trackId, order, addedAt)

// USER & AUTH
User (id, email, emailVerified, name, image, role[USER/PRO/ADMIN], isActive, twoFactorEnabled)
Session, Account, Verification

// USER FEATURES
FavoriteTrack, FavoriteAlbum, FavoritePlaylist
ListeningHistory (id, userId, trackId, playedAt, duration, completed)
Download (id, userId, trackId, licenseType, projectName, downloadedAt)

// ADMIN
AuditLog (id, userId, action, entityType, entityId, metadata)
Notification (id, userId, type, title, message, read, link)
```

# Plan Complet : Parigo MVP vers Application Full-Stack

## Objectif
Transformer Parigo d'un MVP frontend avec mock data en une application complète avec :
- Backend NeonDB (nouvelle base dédiée)
- Données réelles depuis portfolio-caroline + API Spotify pour les tracks
- Stockage assets sur Vercel Blob
- Toutes les features : Auth, Favoris, Labels/Artists pages, Admin Panel, Licences/Download

---

## Phase 1 : Infrastructure Backend

### 1.1 Configuration NeonDB + Prisma

**Fichiers à créer :**
```
/prisma/schema.prisma          # Schéma complet (voir ci-dessous)
/prisma/migrations/            # Auto-généré
/lib/prisma.ts                 # Client Prisma singleton
/prisma.config.ts              # Configuration Prisma
```

**Fichiers à modifier :**
```
/.env.local                    # Ajouter DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL
/package.json                  # Nouvelles dépendances
```

**Dépendances à installer :**
```bash
pnpm add @prisma/client better-auth zod @tanstack/react-query bcryptjs @vercel/blob
pnpm add -D prisma tsx
```

### 1.2 Schéma Prisma Parigo

```prisma
// Modèles principaux (26 tables)

// ASSETS
Asset (id, path, type, mimeType, size, duration, width, height, blurDataUrl)

// TAGS
Genre (id, name, slug, color, order, isActive)
Mood (id, name, slug, color, order, isActive)
Instrument (id, name, slug, icon, order, isActive)

// CONTENT
Label (id, slug, name, description, logoId, website, order, isActive)
Artist (id, slug, name, bio, imageId, order, isActive)
ArtistLink (id, artistId, platform, url, label, order)
Album (id, slug, title, description, coverId, labelId, releaseDate, spotifyUrl, order, isActive, isFeatured)
Track (id, slug, title, albumId, audioId, duration, bpm, key, isVocal, waveform, isrc, trackNumber, order, isActive, playCount)

// RELATIONS MANY-TO-MANY
AlbumGenre, AlbumMood, AlbumArtist
TrackGenre, TrackMood, TrackInstrument, TrackArtist

// PLAYLISTS
Playlist (id, slug, title, description, coverId, userId, isPublic, category, order, isActive, isFeatured)
PlaylistTrack (playlistId, trackId, order, addedAt)

// USER & AUTH
User (id, email, emailVerified, name, image, role[USER/PRO/ADMIN], isActive, twoFactorEnabled)
Session, Account, Verification

// USER FEATURES
FavoriteTrack, FavoriteAlbum, FavoritePlaylist
ListeningHistory (id, userId, trackId, playedAt, duration, completed)
Download (id, userId, trackId, licenseType, projectName, downloadedAt)

// ADMIN
AuditLog (id, userId, action, entityType, entityId, metadata)
Notification (id, userId, type, title, message, read, link)
```

---

## Phase 2 : Migration des Données

### 2.1 Copier les assets de portfolio-caroline

**Fichiers source :**
```
/Users/yoannandrieux/Projets/portfolio-caro/seed-data/
├── artists.json      (100+ artistes)
├── works.json        (200+ albums)
├── categories.json   (5 catégories → genres)
├── labels.json       (4 labels)
```

**Scripts à créer :**
```
/scripts/db/
├── seed.ts                      # Seed principal
├── reset.ts                     # Reset DB
├── migrate-from-portfolio.ts    # Import données portfolio-caro
├── fetch-spotify-tracks.ts      # Récupérer tracks via API Spotify
└── generate-waveforms.ts        # Générer waveforms pour tracks
```

### 2.2 Intégration API Spotify

**Fichiers à créer :**
```
/lib/spotify.ts                  # Client API Spotify
/scripts/spotify/
├── auth.ts                      # OAuth Spotify
└── fetch-album-tracks.ts        # Récupérer tracks d'un album
```

**Flux :**
1. Pour chaque album dans works.json avec spotifyUrl
2. Appeler Spotify API `/albums/{id}/tracks`
3. Récupérer: titre, durée, numéro de piste, ISRC, preview_url
4. Stocker dans table Track

### 2.3 Upload assets vers Vercel Blob

**Script :**
```
/scripts/assets/upload-to-blob.ts
```

**Migration :**
1. Images covers → Vercel Blob `/images/covers/`
2. Images artistes → Vercel Blob `/images/artists/`
3. Audio (si disponible) → Vercel Blob `/audio/tracks/`

```prisma
// Modèles principaux (26 tables)

Mood (id, name, slug, color, order, isActive)
Instrument (id, name, slug, icon, order, isActive)

AlbumGenre, AlbumMood, AlbumArtist
TrackGenre, TrackMood, TrackInstrument, TrackArtist
```

// Parigo - Music Library Platform
// Database Schema for NeonDB (PostgreSQL)

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

// ============================================
// ASSETS (Audio, Images)
// ============================================

model Asset {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  path        String    @unique
  type        AssetType
  mimeType    String?
  size        Int?
  duration    Int?
  width       Int?
  height      Int?
  blurDataUrl String?   @db.Text
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  trackAudio     Track[]    @relation("TrackAudio")
  albumCovers    Album[]    @relation("AlbumCover")
  artistImages   Artist[]   @relation("ArtistImage")
  labelLogos     Label[]    @relation("LabelLogo")
  playlistCovers Playlist[] @relation("PlaylistCover")

  @@index([path])
  @@index([type])
}

enum AssetType {
  AUDIO
  IMAGE
}

// ============================================
// GENRES, MOODS, INSTRUMENTS (Tags)
// ============================================

model Genre {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackGenre[]
  albums AlbumGenre[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model Mood {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackMood[]
  albums AlbumMood[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model Instrument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  icon      String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackInstrument[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// LABELS
// ============================================

model Label {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  name        String
  description String?  @db.Text
  logoId      String?
  logo        Asset?   @relation("LabelLogo", fields: [logoId], references: [id])
  website     String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  albums Album[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// ARTISTS
// ============================================

model Artist {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug      String   @unique
  name      String
  bio       String?  @db.Text
  imageId   String?
  image     Asset?   @relation("ArtistImage", fields: [imageId], references: [id])
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  links        ArtistLink[]
  trackCredits TrackArtist[]
  albumCredits AlbumArtist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([name])
}

model ArtistLink {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  artistId  String
  artist    Artist   @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform  String
  url       String
  label     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([artistId, url])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// ALBUMS
// ============================================

// Parigo - Music Library Platform
// Database Schema for NeonDB (PostgreSQL)

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

// ============================================
// ASSETS (Audio, Images)
// ============================================

model Asset {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  path        String    @unique
  type        AssetType
  mimeType    String?
  size        Int?
  duration    Int?
  width       Int?
  height      Int?
  blurDataUrl String?   @db.Text
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  trackAudio     Track[]    @relation("TrackAudio")
  albumCovers    Album[]    @relation("AlbumCover")
  artistImages   Artist[]   @relation("ArtistImage")
  labelLogos     Label[]    @relation("LabelLogo")
  playlistCovers Playlist[] @relation("PlaylistCover")

  @@index([path])
  @@index([type])
}

enum AssetType {
  AUDIO
  IMAGE
}

// ============================================
// GENRES, MOODS, INSTRUMENTS (Tags)
// ============================================

model Genre {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackGenre[]
  albums AlbumGenre[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model Mood {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackMood[]
  albums AlbumMood[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model Instrument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  icon      String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackInstrument[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// LABELS
// ============================================

model Label {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  name        String
  description String?  @db.Text

  logo        Asset?   @relation("LabelLogo", fields: [logoId], references: [id])
  website     String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  albums Album[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([name])
}

  @@index([artistId])

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The conversation is summarized below:
Analysis:
Let me chronologically analyze this conversation:

1. **Initial User Request**: The user asked to look at the "portfolio-caroline" project in the parent folder to find real data (projects, albums, synchros, artists, etc.) and create a backend for "parigo" with NeonDB similar to portfolio-caroline. They want to replace all mock data and create a complete plan beyond MVP.

2. **Planning Phase**: I launched exploration agents to understand both projects:
   - portfolio-caroline: Has a complete NeonDB/Prisma backend with 21 models, 100+ artists, 200+ works, etc.
   - parigo: MVP Next.js app with mock data (12 albums, 129 tracks, 6 playlists)

3. **User Questions Answered**:
   - Tracks: Generate via Spotify API
   - NeonDB: Create new dedicated database for Parigo
   - Assets: Vercel Blob
   - Priorities: ALL features (Auth + Favoris, Pages Labels/Artists, Admin Panel, Licences/Download)

4. **Implementation Started**:
   - Created ROADMAP.md
   - Setup NeonDB (project: cold-star-94191393)
   - Installed dependencies (had to use Prisma 5.22.0 due to Node version)
   - Created complete Prisma schema (26 tables)
   - Created seed script and seeded database (20 genres, 12 moods, 10 instruments, 5 labels, 69 artists, 30 albums)
   - Created all API routes (albums, tracks, search, artists, labels, playlists, genres, moods)
   - Had to fix type error in albums/[id] route

5. **Second User Message**: "tu peux continuer avec les deux ultrathink" - Continue with both Spotify integration AND frontend migration

6. **Current Work**:
   - Created Spotify client and fetch tracks script
   - Created API client (api-client.ts)
   - Created React Query hooks (use-api.ts)
   - Created QueryProvider
   - Updated layout.tsx to include QueryProvider
   - Updated types/index.ts to support API response formats
   - Updated PlaylistCard to use trackCount
   - Migrated home page (page.tsx) to use API hooks
   - Migrated albums page to use API hooks
   - Still need to migrate search page and album detail page

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The user wants to transform Parigo from a MVP frontend with mock data into a complete full-stack application by:
   - Creating a NeonDB backend (similar to portfolio-caroline)
   - Importing real data from portfolio-caroline's seed-data
   - Integrating Spotify API to fetch track details
   - Migrating frontend from mock data to real API calls
   - Eventually implementing all features: Auth, Favoris, Labels/Artists pages, Admin Panel, Licences/Download

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - NeonDB (PostgreSQL serverless)
   - Prisma ORM v5.22.0 (limited by Node 22.8.0 version)
   - Next.js 16.1.1 with App Router
   - React Query (@tanstack/react-query) for data fetching
   - Spotify Web API for fetching track metadata
   - Better Auth for authentication (planned)
   - Vercel Blob for asset storage (planned)
   - Zustand for state management (existing)

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **/Users/yoannandrieux/Projets/parigo/ROADMAP.md**
     - Tracks development progress across 6 sprints
     - Sprint 1 completed, Sprint 2 partially completed

   - **/Users/yoannandrieux/Projets/parigo/prisma/schema.prisma**
     - Complete 26-table schema for music library platform
     - Includes: Asset, Genre, Mood, Instrument, Label, Artist, ArtistLink, Album, Track, Playlist, User, Session, Account, FavoriteTrack/Album/Playlist, ListeningHistory, Download, AuditLog, Notification
     - Many-to-many relations via junction tables (AlbumGenre, TrackMood, etc.)

   - **/Users/yoannandrieux/Projets/parigo/src/lib/prisma.ts**
     - Prisma client singleton pattern
     ```typescript
     import { PrismaClient } from "@prisma/client";
     const globalForPrisma = globalThis as unknown as { prisma: PrismaClient | undefined };
     export const prisma = globalForPrisma.prisma ?? new PrismaClient({...});
     ```

   - **/Users/yoannandrieux/Projets/parigo/scripts/db/seed.ts**
     - Seeds genres, moods, instruments, labels, artists, albums
     - Imports data from seed-data/*.json files
     - Result: 20 genres, 12 moods, 10 instruments, 5 labels, 69 artists, 30 albums

   - **/Users/yoannandrieux/Projets/parigo/src/lib/spotify/client.ts**
     - Spotify API client with Client Credentials flow

   - **pnpm store version mismatch**: Fixed by running `rm -rf node_modules && pnpm install`
   - **Prisma Node.js version error**: Prisma 7.x requires Node 20.19+ or 22.12+. Fixed by downgrading to Prisma 5.22.0 (compatible with Node 22.8.0)

   - Created comprehensive seed script that maps portfolio-caroline data to Parigo's schema

Tu peux copier toutes les infos dont tu vas avoir besoin du projet portfolio-caroline, vers ce projet pargio. tu peux créer la DB avec néon tu as le CLI. ultrathink et propose moi un plan ultra complet pour aller au dela du projet MVP, je veux que l'on continu toutes les features parigo."

## Résumé de la migration

**Sprint 2 terminé !** Voici ce qui a été accompli :

### API Routes créées
- `/api/albums` - Liste avec filtres (label, genre, featured)

- `/api/tracks` - Recherche avancée (query, genres, moods, instruments, BPM, durée, vocal)

- `/api/artists`, `/api/labels`, `/api/playlists`
- `/api/genres`, `/api/moods`, `/api/instruments`

### Frontend migré
- **Page d'accueil** (`page.tsx`) - Albums et playlists featured via API

- **Page album détail** (`albums/[id]/page.tsx`) - Tracks et albums similaires depuis API
- **Page search** (`search/page.tsx`) - Filtres avancés côté serveur

### Infrastructure
- Client API (`lib/api-client.ts`)
- Hooks React Query (`hooks/use-api.ts`)
- QueryProvider pour React Query
- Client Spotify prêt (`lib/spotify/client.ts`)
- Script de fetch tracks (`scripts/spotify/fetch-tracks.ts`)

1. **Ajouter les credentials Spotify** (`SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID`, `SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET`) puis exécuter `pnpm tsx scripts/spotify/fetch-tracks.ts` pour importer les tracks
2. **Passer au Sprint 3** - Authentification avec Better Auth et système de favoris

model User {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())

  emailVerified    Boolean   @default(false)

  sessions          Session[]
  accounts          Account[]
  playlists         Playlist[]
  favoriteTracks    FavoriteTrack[]
  favoriteAlbums    FavoriteAlbum[]
  favoritePlaylists FavoritePlaylist[]
  listeningHistory  ListeningHistory[]
  downloads         Download[]
  auditLogs         AuditLog[]
  notifications     Notification[]

  @@index([email])
  @@index([role, isActive])
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?  @db.Text
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([token])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model Account {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  user         User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  accountId    String
  providerId   String
  accessToken  String?   @db.Text
  refreshToken String?   @db.Text
  expiresAt    DateTime?
  password     String?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@unique([providerId, accountId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Verification {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime

  @@index([userId])

// Parigo - Music Library Platform
// Database Schema for NeonDB (PostgreSQL)

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

// ============================================
// ASSETS (Audio, Images)
// ============================================

model Asset {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  path        String    @unique
  type        AssetType
  mimeType    String?
  size        Int?
  duration    Int?
  width       Int?
  height      Int?
  blurDataUrl String?   @db.Text
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  trackAudio     Track[]    @relation("TrackAudio")
  albumCovers    Album[]    @relation("AlbumCover")
  artistImages   Artist[]   @relation("ArtistImage")
  labelLogos     Label[]    @relation("LabelLogo")
  playlistCovers Playlist[] @relation("PlaylistCover")

  @@index([path])
  @@index([type])
}

enum AssetType {
  AUDIO
  IMAGE
}

// ============================================
// GENRES, MOODS, INSTRUMENTS (Tags)
// ============================================

model Genre {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackGenre[]
  albums AlbumGenre[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model Mood {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackMood[]
  albums AlbumMood[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model Instrument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  icon      String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackInstrument[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// LABELS
// ============================================

model Label {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  name        String
  description String?  @db.Text
  logoId      String?
  logo        Asset?   @relation("LabelLogo", fields: [logoId], references: [id])
  website     String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  albums Album[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// ARTISTS
// ============================================

model Artist {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug      String   @unique
  name      String
  bio       String?  @db.Text
  imageId   String?
  image     Asset?   @relation("ArtistImage", fields: [imageId], references: [id])
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  links        ArtistLink[]
  trackCredits TrackArtist[]
  albumCredits AlbumArtist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([name])
}

model ArtistLink {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  artistId  String
  artist    Artist   @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform  String
  url       String
  label     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([artistId, url])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// ALBUMS
// ============================================

model Album {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String    @unique
  title       String
  description String?   @db.Text
  coverId     String?
  cover       Asset?    @relation("AlbumCover", fields: [coverId], references: [id])
  labelId     String?
  label       Label?    @relation(fields: [labelId], references: [id])
  releaseDate DateTime?
  year        Int?
  spotifyUrl  String?
  spotifyId   String?
  order       Int       @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean   @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean   @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  tracks    Track[]
  genres    AlbumGenre[]
  moods     AlbumMood[]
  artists   AlbumArtist[]
  favorites FavoriteAlbum[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([labelId])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([isFeatured, isActive])
  @@index([spotifyId])
}

model AlbumGenre {
  albumId String
  album   Album  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  genreId String
  genre   Genre  @relation(fields: [genreId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([albumId, genreId])
}

model AlbumMood {
  albumId String
  album   Album @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  moodId  String
  mood    Mood  @relation(fields: [moodId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([albumId, moodId])
}

model AlbumArtist {
  albumId  String
  album    Album  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artistId String
  artist   Artist @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role     String?
  order    Int    @default(0)

  @@id([albumId, artistId])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// TRACKS
// ============================================

model Track {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  albumId     String
  album       Album    @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  audioId     String?
  audio       Asset?   @relation("TrackAudio", fields: [audioId], references: [id])
  duration    Int
  bpm         Int?
  key         String?
  isVocal     Boolean  @default(false)
  waveform    Json?
  isrc        String?
  spotifyId   String?
  previewUrl  String?
  trackNumber Int?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  playCount   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  genres         TrackGenre[]
  moods          TrackMood[]
  instruments    TrackInstrument[]
  artists        TrackArtist[]
  playlistTracks PlaylistTrack[]
  favorites      FavoriteTrack[]
  historyEntries ListeningHistory[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([albumId])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([spotifyId])
}

model TrackGenre {
  trackId String
  track   Track  @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  genreId String
  genre   Genre  @relation(fields: [genreId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, genreId])
}

model TrackMood {
  trackId String
  track   Track @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  moodId  String
  mood    Mood  @relation(fields: [moodId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, moodId])
}

model TrackInstrument {
  trackId      String
  track        Track      @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  instrumentId String
  instrument   Instrument @relation(fields: [instrumentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, instrumentId])
}

model TrackArtist {
  trackId  String
  track    Track  @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artistId String
  artist   Artist @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role     String?
  order    Int    @default(0)

  @@id([trackId, artistId])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// PLAYLISTS
// ============================================

model Playlist {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  description String?  @db.Text
  coverId     String?
  cover       Asset?   @relation("PlaylistCover", fields: [coverId], references: [id])
  userId      String?
  user        User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  isPublic    Boolean  @default(true)
  category    String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  tracks    PlaylistTrack[]
  favorites FavoritePlaylist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([isPublic, isActive])
  @@index([isFeatured, isActive])
  @@index([category])
}

model PlaylistTrack {
  playlistId String
  playlist   Playlist @relation(fields: [playlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId    String
  track      Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order      Int      @default(0)
  addedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([playlistId, trackId])
  @@index([playlistId, order])
}

// ============================================
// USER & AUTHENTICATION
// ============================================

enum UserRole {
  USER
  PRO
  ADMIN
}

model User {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  email            String    @unique
  emailVerified    Boolean   @default(false)
  name             String?
  image            String?
  role             UserRole  @default(USER)
  isActive         Boolean   @default(true)
  twoFactorSecret  String?
  twoFactorEnabled Boolean   @default(false)
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt

  sessions          Session[]
  accounts          Account[]
  playlists         Playlist[]
  favoriteTracks    FavoriteTrack[]
  favoriteAlbums    FavoriteAlbum[]
  favoritePlaylists FavoritePlaylist[]
  listeningHistory  ListeningHistory[]
  downloads         Download[]
  auditLogs         AuditLog[]
  notifications     Notification[]

  @@index([email])
  @@index([role, isActive])
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?  @db.Text
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([token])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model Account {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  user         User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  accountId    String
  providerId   String
  accessToken  String?   @db.Text
  refreshToken String?   @db.Text
  expiresAt    DateTime?
  password     String?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@unique([providerId, accountId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Verification {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([identifier, value])
  @@index([identifier])
}

// ============================================
// FAVORITES
// ============================================

model FavoriteTrack {
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId   String
  track     Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, trackId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model FavoriteAlbum {
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  albumId   String
  album     Album    @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, albumId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model FavoritePlaylist {
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  playlistId String
  playlist   Playlist @relation(fields: [playlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, playlistId])
  @@index([userId])
}

// ============================================
// LISTENING HISTORY
// ============================================

model ListeningHistory {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId   String
  track     Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  playedAt  DateTime @default(now())
  duration  Int?
  completed Boolean  @default(false)

  @@index([userId, playedAt])
  @@index([trackId])
}

// ============================================
// DOWNLOADS & LICENSES
// ============================================

enum LicenseType {
  PREVIEW
  STANDARD
  EXTENDED
  EXCLUSIVE
}

model Download {
  id           String      @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  user         User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId      String
  licenseType  LicenseType
  projectName  String?
  usageNotes   String?     @db.Text
  ipAddress    String?
  downloadedAt DateTime    @default(now())
  expiresAt    DateTime?

  @@index([userId, downloadedAt])
  @@index([trackId])
}

// ============================================
// AUDIT & NOTIFICATIONS
// ============================================

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  action     String
  entityType String?
  entityId   String?
  metadata   Json?
  ipAddress  String?
  userAgent  String?  @db.Text
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([entityType, entityId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type      String
  title     String
  message   String   @db.Text
  read      Boolean  @default(false)
  link      String?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, read])
  @@index([createdAt])
}
