// Parigo - Music Library Platform
// Database Schema for NeonDB (PostgreSQL)

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider  = "postgresql"
  url       = env("DATABASE_URL")
  directUrl = env("DIRECT_URL")
}

// ============================================
// ASSETS (Audio, Images)
// ============================================

model Asset {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  path        String    @unique
  type        AssetType
  mimeType    String?
  size        Int?
  duration    Int?
  width       Int?
  height      Int?
  blurDataUrl String?   @db.Text
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  // Relations
  trackAudio     Track[]    @relation("TrackAudio")
  albumCovers    Album[]    @relation("AlbumCover")
  artistImages   Artist[]   @relation("ArtistImage")
  labelLogos     Label[]    @relation("LabelLogo")
  playlistCovers Playlist[] @relation("PlaylistCover")

  @@index([path])
  @@index([type])
}

enum AssetType {
  AUDIO
  IMAGE
}

// ============================================
// GENRES, MOODS, INSTRUMENTS (Tags)
// ============================================

model Genre {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackGenre[]
  albums AlbumGenre[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model Mood {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  color     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackMood[]
  albums AlbumMood[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

model Instrument {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  name      String   @unique
  slug      String   @unique
  icon      String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  tracks TrackInstrument[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// LABELS
// ============================================

model Label {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  name        String
  description String?  @db.Text
  logoId      String?
  logo        Asset?   @relation("LabelLogo", fields: [logoId], references: [id])
  website     String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  albums Album[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
}

// ============================================
// ARTISTS
// ============================================

model Artist {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug      String   @unique
  name      String
  bio       String?  @db.Text
  imageId   String?
  image     Asset?   @relation("ArtistImage", fields: [imageId], references: [id])
  order     Int      @default(0)
  isActive  Boolean  @default(true)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  links        ArtistLink[]
  trackCredits TrackArtist[]
  albumCredits AlbumArtist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([name])
}

model ArtistLink {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  artistId  String
  artist    Artist   @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  platform  String
  url       String
  label     String?
  order     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([artistId, url])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// ALBUMS
// ============================================

model Album {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String    @unique
  title       String
  description String?   @db.Text
  coverId     String?
  cover       Asset?    @relation("AlbumCover", fields: [coverId], references: [id])
  labelId     String?
  label       Label?    @relation(fields: [labelId], references: [id])
  releaseDate DateTime?
  year        Int?
  spotifyUrl  String?
  spotifyId   String?
  order       Int       @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean   @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean   @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt

  tracks    Track[]
  genres    AlbumGenre[]
  moods     AlbumMood[]
  artists   AlbumArtist[]
  favorites FavoriteAlbum[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([labelId])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([isFeatured, isActive])
  @@index([spotifyId])
}

model AlbumGenre {
  albumId String
  album   Album  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  genreId String
  genre   Genre  @relation(fields: [genreId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([albumId, genreId])
}

model AlbumMood {
  albumId String
  album   Album @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  moodId  String
  mood    Mood  @relation(fields: [moodId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([albumId, moodId])
}

model AlbumArtist {
  albumId  String
  album    Album  @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artistId String
  artist   Artist @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role     String?
  order    Int    @default(0)

  @@id([albumId, artistId])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// TRACKS
// ============================================

model Track {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  albumId     String
  album       Album    @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  audioId     String?
  audio       Asset?   @relation("TrackAudio", fields: [audioId], references: [id])
  duration    Int
  bpm         Int?
  key         String?
  isVocal     Boolean  @default(false)
  waveform    Json?
  isrc        String?
  spotifyId   String?
  previewUrl  String?
  trackNumber Int?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  playCount   Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  genres         TrackGenre[]
  moods          TrackMood[]
  instruments    TrackInstrument[]
  artists        TrackArtist[]
  playlistTracks PlaylistTrack[]
  favorites      FavoriteTrack[]
  historyEntries ListeningHistory[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([albumId])
  @@index([isActive, order])
  @@index([spotifyId])
}

model TrackGenre {
  trackId String
  track   Track  @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  genreId String
  genre   Genre  @relation(fields: [genreId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, genreId])
}

model TrackMood {
  trackId String
  track   Track @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  moodId  String
  mood    Mood  @relation(fields: [moodId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, moodId])
}

model TrackInstrument {
  trackId      String
  track        Track      @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  instrumentId String
  instrument   Instrument @relation(fields: [instrumentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@id([trackId, instrumentId])
}

model TrackArtist {
  trackId  String
  track    Track  @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artistId String
  artist   Artist @relation(fields: [artistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  role     String?
  order    Int    @default(0)

  @@id([trackId, artistId])
  @@index([artistId])
}

// ============================================
// PLAYLISTS
// ============================================

model Playlist {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug        String   @unique
  title       String
  description String?  @db.Text
  coverId     String?
  cover       Asset?   @relation("PlaylistCover", fields: [coverId], references: [id])
  userId      String?
  user        User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  isPublic    Boolean  @default(true)
  category    String?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  isActive    Boolean  @default(true)
  isFeatured  Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  tracks    PlaylistTrack[]
  favorites FavoritePlaylist[]

  @@index([slug])
  @@index([userId])
  @@index([isPublic, isActive])
  @@index([isFeatured, isActive])
  @@index([category])
}

model PlaylistTrack {
  playlistId String
  playlist   Playlist @relation(fields: [playlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId    String
  track      Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  order      Int      @default(0)
  addedAt    DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([playlistId, trackId])
  @@index([playlistId, order])
}

// ============================================
// USER & AUTHENTICATION
// ============================================

enum UserRole {
  USER
  PRO
  ADMIN
}

model User {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  email            String    @unique
  emailVerified    Boolean   @default(false)
  name             String?
  image            String?
  role             UserRole  @default(USER)
  isActive         Boolean   @default(true)
  twoFactorSecret  String?
  twoFactorEnabled Boolean   @default(false)
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt

  sessions          Session[]
  accounts          Account[]
  playlists         Playlist[]
  favoriteTracks    FavoriteTrack[]
  favoriteAlbums    FavoriteAlbum[]
  favoritePlaylists FavoritePlaylist[]
  listeningHistory  ListeningHistory[]
  downloads         Download[]
  auditLogs         AuditLog[]
  notifications     Notification[]

  @@index([email])
  @@index([role, isActive])
}

model Session {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  token     String   @unique
  expiresAt DateTime
  ipAddress String?
  userAgent String?  @db.Text
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([token])
  @@index([expiresAt])
}

model Account {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  user         User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  accountId    String
  providerId   String
  accessToken  String?   @db.Text
  refreshToken String?   @db.Text
  expiresAt    DateTime?
  password     String?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@unique([providerId, accountId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model Verification {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  identifier String
  value      String
  expiresAt  DateTime
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([identifier, value])
  @@index([identifier])
}

// ============================================
// FAVORITES
// ============================================

model FavoriteTrack {
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId   String
  track     Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, trackId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model FavoriteAlbum {
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  albumId   String
  album     Album    @relation(fields: [albumId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, albumId])
  @@index([userId])
}

model FavoritePlaylist {
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  playlistId String
  playlist   Playlist @relation(fields: [playlistId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([userId, playlistId])
  @@index([userId])
}

// ============================================
// LISTENING HISTORY
// ============================================

model ListeningHistory {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId   String
  track     Track    @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  playedAt  DateTime @default(now())
  duration  Int?
  completed Boolean  @default(false)

  @@index([userId, playedAt])
  @@index([trackId])
}

// ============================================
// DOWNLOADS & LICENSES
// ============================================

enum LicenseType {
  PREVIEW
  STANDARD
  EXTENDED
  EXCLUSIVE
}

model Download {
  id           String      @id @default(cuid())
  userId       String
  user         User        @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  trackId      String
  track        Track       @relation(fields: [trackId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  licenseType  LicenseType
  projectName  String?
  usageNotes   String?     @db.Text
  ipAddress    String?
  downloadedAt DateTime    @default(now())
  expiresAt    DateTime?

  @@index([userId, downloadedAt])
  @@index([trackId])
}

// ============================================
// AUDIT & NOTIFICATIONS
// ============================================

model AuditLog {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId     String
  user       User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  action     String
  entityType String?
  entityId   String?
  metadata   Json?
  ipAddress  String?
  userAgent  String?  @db.Text
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
  @@index([entityType, entityId])
  @@index([createdAt])
}

model Notification {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  type      String
  title     String
  message   String   @db.Text
  read      Boolean  @default(false)
  link      String?
  metadata  Json?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([userId, read])
  @@index([createdAt])
}
